title: One texture, three loupes
label: Lab tray: a picture card in a back rail; recessed dot-grid wells, each half the last, dots darkening towards a sampled cluster. Two open loupes stand on level 0, a tiny one on level 2; ruler ticks and level pips line the front rim.
caption: The picture is uploaded once and every smaller level is made from it; each loupe reads the well whose dot size matches its own, so the tiny loupe samples level 2, not the full picture.
